changeSet.author: security-review
changeSet.comment: Suppress Supabase lint 0010_security_definer_view: the view is intentionally security definer to aggregate all verified matches for a public ladder, bypassing RLS that restricts match visibility to participants. Only aggregate counts for public profiles are exposed.
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON VIEW public.v_player_records IS '@supabase/lint-disable 0010_security_definer_view -- Intentional: public ladder aggregates all verified matches for public profiles; exposes only counts, not match rows; same data as /players/:id/stats.';
changeSet.rollback: COMMENT ON VIEW public.v_player_records IS NULL;
